import sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd().resolve()
sys.path[:0]=[str(root),str(root/'src'),str(root/'contract')]
from scripts import u2_inputs, vendor_rk
import rkuarch, uarch_contract
assert u2_inputs.ROOT == vendor_rk.ROOT == root
for module in (u2_inputs,vendor_rk,rkuarch,uarch_contract):
 assert Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(root)
import pytest
raise SystemExit(pytest.main(sys.argv[1:]))
